The Hanno Ecotourism Association invites you to participate in conservation work at the water habitats where Tokyo salamanders lay their eggs in the satoyama (traditional village forest).

【Fee】Adults ¥3,000 | Students ¥2,500 | Preschool children ¥1,500 (includes guide, insurance, and materials)

【Capacity】20 people

【Guide】Mori no Field Manabiya staff

【What to bring】Drinking water, lunch, work gloves, change of clothes, towel, waterproof boots

【Note】For more information, visit Mori no Field Manabiya: https://morinomanabiya168.wixsite.com/website
location: 集合 飯能市立博物館前（国際興業バス「OH!!!・天覧山下」または」「市民会館・博物館」下車徒歩3分）
